item: Unreadable counts say so; gzip wire-bytes test follows ASGI
summary: render._md_disclosures prints that a quarantined-article count or an undated-mention count could not be read (unknown, not zero) instead of Nothing excluded, and an unknown baseline keeps its not-assumed-complete note; two sentences in all 11 bulletin catalogs (373 keys each), a test per count that fails if the unread branch prints Nothing excluded, a per-locale translated-print test. The gzip wire-bytes test helper now answers http.disconnect after the response like a server (starlette 1.8.0 rejected the endless http.request; CI installs the web stack unpinned), and the two gate-probe tests search the whole capability record so they hold under the CPU/RAM floor.
